name: Onondaga County, NY
findings: Onondaga County has 1,794 nonprofit organizations. 921 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 790 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Onondaga County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
